notes: Azeri/Kurdish/Gilaki northwest. 19.2m upper-normal; Hamadan and Qazvin are edge provinces added for balance.

original_coverage_E: Armenia, Azerbaijan (incl. Nakhchivan and Nagorno-Karabakh area) and Georgia (incl. Abkhazia and South Ossetia) - three entire countries.
coverage_T: Armenia [entire ADM0]; Azerbaijan [entire ADM0]; Georgia [entire ADM0]
changes_vs_old: Azerbaijan added (entire ADM0) to former Armenia-Georgia seat (old 6.7m, too small).
notes: Rule 2 block of three entire countries with mutual land borders (Georgia-Armenia, Georgia-Azerbaijan, Armenia-Azerbaijan). Culturally debatable (distinct languages/religions) but a coherent South Caucasus region; chosen because Azerbaijan+NW Iran (29.1m) was too big and Armenia+Georgia (6.7m) too small. Nakhchivan is an Azerbaijani exclave (separated by Armenia) - same ADM0, no sovereignty statement; Abkhazia/South Ossetia included as parts of Georgia, Nagorno-Karabakh as part of Azerbaijan. Pop = WPP 2026: Azerbaijan 10.30m + Georgia 3.80m + Armenia 3.00m.
